per_geometry_device_qualification.reason: Count-four paired roots pass both devices and five matched sequential/concurrent pairs; all other required mixed counts still need qualification.

evidence.resource_admission_note: Completed paired repetitions used 12/11 Rayon threads, 7/6 GiB managed GPU memory, 512 MiB context per GPU, 18 GiB RAM and 14.25 GiB spill per worker, a 37.5 GiB fleet cap and no swap. All worker and parent memory-event deltas were zero. Context calibration is tied to the pinned paired binary/profile/device/driver/managed allocation; it does not transfer to query gather or other counts.
